headline: Uber, TSMC and Norwegian confirm breaches; Check Point PHP2Shell and N-central zero-days still exploited

bullets.text: New breaches: Uber says hackers stole thousands of drivers' license records; TSMC confirms an employee data breach tied to a cloud service provider; over 144,000 Norwegian and Wideroe passengers are affected. Belarusian cloud firm ActiveCloud was hit by ransomware, disrupting customers for days.

FBI: North Korean hackers stole over $400 million in crypto using deepfake video calls built from stolen webcam clips of 900+ victims in a fake Zoom scheme. Separately, Trezor confirms hidden implants in CryptoBilis-sold wallets that can steal recovery phrases.
PHP2Shell (5 outlets): Check Point zero-day CVE-2026-123039 is exploited for root on gateways; attackers deploy a TSGA backdoor and wipe ESXi files. No fixed release version is on the board.

N-central (PoC, 5 outlets): the N-able zero-day was exploited hours after a PoC; 21 servers infected, 19 on Hotfix 2, so patched servers are not safe. MSPs (8 outlets): worm-like SCKit spreads through ScreenConnect support sessions.

Still active: Nitori may have leaked 37.62M member records; Operation Endgame hit Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC (DOJ ties Gootloader to 44+ ransomware attacks); Apache httpd CVE-2026-119618; SignDrop Windows zero-day; Apify and Fireworks AI breaches.

KEV due today (11-13): Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560. Due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. SITCON 3; last 7 days run 1.13x the 90-day average.

actions: Check Point: apply the vendor fix for CVE-2026-123039, limit gateway management to trusted networks, and hunt for TSGA backdoor indicators.
N-central: treat servers as exposed even on Hotfix 2; take consoles off the internet and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions and hunt for SCKit spreading from support sessions.
Warn finance and crypto staff about deepfake video-call lures; verify payment or wallet requests out of band.
Patch Barracuda ESG today (KEV deadline 11-13) and Apache httpd for CVE-2026-119618; queue BroadWorks, Outlook and Chromium before 11-24.
Check Have I Been Pwned for CastleRAT stealer logins on your domains and reset affected credentials and sessions.
